create.ucm.customer_profile.create: Creates a new customer profile entry.

create.ucm.customer_profile.manage_system_data: Allows creation of system data related to customer profile.

touch.ucm.bank_account.touch: Triggers evaluation utilising latest submitted data.

submit.ucm.bank_account.submit: Submits latest draft data for evaluation.

delete.ucm.bank_account.delete: Deletes the bank account data in draft.

create.ucm.bank_account.create: Creates a new bank account entry in draft.

create.ucm.bank_account.manage_system_data: Allows creation of system data related to bank accounts.

view.ucm.bank_account.view_basic: Allows viewing of bank account data but account numbers are masked.

view.ucm.bank_account.view_standard: Allows viewing of bank account details including unmasked bank account data.

view.ucm.bank_account.view_system_data: Allows viewing of system data related to a bank account.

view.ucm.bank_account.view_soft_deleted: Allows viewing of a soft deleted bank account.

update.ucm.bank_account.update_basic: Allows updating of bank account data without account number in draft.

update.ucm.bank_account.update_standard: Allows management of bank account account data including bank account numbers.

update.ucm.bank_account.manage_system_data: Allows management of system data related to bank accounts.

update.ucm.bank_account.manage_soft_deleted: Allows managing of a soft deleted bank account.
